evals.name: Interactive 3D Mountain Terrain
evals.prompt: Create an interactive 3D terrain map centered on Mount Everest with realistic elevation relief, atmospheric sky horizon, and camera pitch controls.
evals.expected_output: A complete, self-contained HTML page using native MapLibre GL JS with explicit container CSS height, configuring a raster-dem elevation source via MapTiler terrain-rgb tiles, enabling map.setTerrain with exaggeration, setting a sky layer, and using proper [lng, lat] coordinate center.

evals.name: Point Clustering with Dynamic Bubbles
evals.prompt: Build an interactive vector map showing earthquake locations with point clustering, dynamic count badges, and click-to-zoom expansion.
evals.expected_output: A standalone HTML page using MapLibre GL JS with a GeoJSON source with cluster: true, clusterMaxZoom, clusterRadius, three circle layers styled using step expressions for count thresholds, symbol layer with text-field '{point_count_abbreviated}', and click handler querying getClusterExpansionZoom.

evals.name: Extruded 3D Urban Buildings
evals.prompt: Create an interactive map of Tokyo with 3D buildings extrusion that change color based on height.
evals.expected_output: A standalone HTML page with pitch set to 60 degrees, a fill-extrusion layer sourced from the vector tile 'building' source-layer (MapTiler Planet v4), with fill-extrusion-height and fill-extrusion-base expressions, and fill-extrusion-color styling.

evals.name: Smooth 60 FPS Route Marker Animation
evals.prompt: Create a smooth animated marker moving along a delivery flight route at 60 FPS in MapLibre GL JS.
evals.expected_output: A standalone HTML page with a GeoJSON LineString route, Turf.js or interpolation math calculating coordinate positions over time, requestAnimationFrame loop updating a point GeoJSON source or marker coordinate, and bearing rotation.

evals.name: Satellite Imagery with 3D Mountain Terrain
evals.prompt: Create an interactive satellite map with 3D mountain terrain elevation and topographic contour lines.
evals.expected_output: A complete HTML page using MapLibre GL JS importing maplibre-gl CSS and JS, setting style to MapTiler hybrid-v4, adding a raster-dem terrain source with map.setTerrain, and configuring vector contour lines.
